column1: # Each row is a family the audit confirmed on 8a786c595; the identity batch's
# A1/B1/B2 lanes fix the family and delete the row in the same change.

column5: W1 (D554-1/R1): dot-call dispatch picks the last-registered impl instead of the inherent method
W1/R4: same leaf mechanism as w1a, structural D509 witness case
W1/R1: the checker conflates same-named methods across unrelated traits into one signature, refusing a program that declares two disjoint `size` methods on different traits
W2/R2: a user trait spelled Clone is matched as the Clone marker by spelling
W3/R3: user `len`/`to_string`/`assert_eq` declarations do not shadow the builtins; callee resolution picks the builtin regardless of scope
W3/R3: callee resolution does not consult the lexical scope before the module fn table, so a local closure fails to shadow a same-named fn
W3/R3: same family as w3a; a user `fn println` does not shadow the builtin `println`
W11: the machine companion event (known_types, a String) cannot carry a DefId, so the duplicate-declaration note points at the user type instead of the owning machine
